title: Putin's Russia
description: An exploration of Russian culture and politics under the controversial leadership of Vladimir Putin. Topics may include Putin's rise to power, the Pussy Riot scandal, LGBTQ2S+ rights under Putin, the Sochi Olympics and Russian-Ukrainian conflict.
notes: Credit will be granted for only one of SLST 461, SLST 410 (if taken in the same topic), HSTR 352A.
